proposal.root_cause: Commit 2f39726 switched api-b to the private image ghcr.io/akashdeepsinghjassal/api-b-private:1.0.0, which cannot be pulled (403 Forbidden from ghcr.io, so the regcred pull secret is missing or invalid). The pod is stuck in ErrImagePull.
proposal.rationale: The git diff of 2f39726 shows the image was previously python:3.12-alpine, the last known good value. The app code comes from the api-b-code ConfigMap mounted at /app, so the public base image works. The imagePullSecrets entry is left as is.
proposal.verify: The api-b pod pulls python:3.12-alpine, becomes Ready, and the Deployment rolls out in demo-b.

metadata:
  name: api-b
  namespace: demo-b

  replicas: 1

    matchLabels:
      app: api-b
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-b
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"

      [REDACTED] name: regcred
      containers:
        - name: api-b
          image: ghcr.io/akashdeepsinghjassal/api-b-private:1.0.0

                name: api-b-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 96Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:

              cpu: 500m

            name: api-b-code
